name: Punkah
description: A punkah: one broad blade swung from the top edge, with a narrower one behind it.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: conic-gradient(from 150deg at 50% 0%, #000 0 60deg, transparent 60deg 360deg); mask: conic-gradient(from 150deg at 50% 0%, #000 0 60deg, transparent 60deg 360deg); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: conic-gradient(from 167deg at 50% 0%, #000 0 26deg, transparent 26deg 360deg); mask: conic-gradient(from 167deg at 50% 0%, #000 0 26deg, transparent 26deg 360deg); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
